title: LMS-NG MQTT presence v2
description: Published RETAINED to status/presence/{gatewayId}. Merges v1's separate birth+will retained topics into one, carrying a monotonic connectionSeq so two retained values can never disagree with each other (revised plan section A.4/R09, test O06). elevatorId is null -- this is gateway-scoped.

connectionId.description: One per MQTT connection/session. A new connectionId always wins over an old one's stale retained value -- a will from a previous connectionId must never override the current connection's ONLINE presence (test O06).

connectionSeq.description: Incremented on every connect. Durable, assigned in the same transaction as the connection is registered.

preparedAt.description: For an LWT-sourced OFFLINE presence: the time the will payload was PREPARED at CONNECT time, never mislabelled as the time the disconnect actually happened (revised plan section A.4, test C08). Null for a live CONNECT/SHUTDOWN presence, where eventTime/observedAt already carry the real time.
